_about: Curated list for graphics post 13 (research frontiers 2026), as of 2026-11-02. status: published = presented at / published by a 2026 venue that has already taken place; accepted = accepted / to appear (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 is 1-4 Dec 2026, or accepted to a journal); preprint = arXiv only, no venue confirmed. month: venue month for conference papers (published or to appear), arXiv v1 month otherwise. builds_on: blog slugs that teach the prerequisites. Every entry was checked against its arXiv abstract page, DOI record (Crossref) or official project page.
